description: TuRBO is a structured observation framework for in-action team reflection in acute care teams, adapted in this study from Schmutz et al.
title: TuRBO (Team Reflection Behavioral Observation) coding framework

description: The review proposes a universal validation criterion for simulated learners modeled on Turing's Test.
title: Turing-like validation criterion for simulated learners

description: An observational scheme coding every speaker turn for codes such as ELI, EL, REI, RE, OI, UC, Q, SC, RC, RB and RW, plus five holistic lesson-level ratings (Aims, Monitoring, Reflection, Talk Rules, Student Participation).
title: Turn-level and lesson-level classroom dialogue coding

description: TEI is a fixed-weight linear index over four signals computed without any external model at selection time: \"a Schoenfeld-Verify keyword ratio, a math-step density, an ends-question rate, and a deep-reasoning gate from the Deep-Thinking Ratio (DTR) probe\".
title: Tutoring Effectiveness Index (TEI)
